name: Randall's Auto Upholstery
addr: 200 Black Mountain Ave, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: Had a great experience. I went in and set up an appointment. Took my truck in and seat was ready in just a few hours after dropping it off. Great quality and craftsmanship. Adding before and after photo of seat.

Randall’s Auto Upholstery did an absolutely amazing job on my son’s Volkswagen GTI headliner. Anyone who knows these cars understands that GTIs are not an easy vehicle when it comes to headliners—many shops won’t even touch them. But Randall took it on and the result is flawless. The headliner looks like it was always meant to be there, factory-perfect. The process was quick, smooth, and stress-free. Randall was professional, easy to work with, and delivered top-notch craftsmanship. I couldn’t be more grateful for the quality of the work and the excellent service. Highly recommend Randall’s Auto Upholstery! If I ever need upholstery work on another vehicle, this is the only place I’ll be calling.

Needed to have my truck seat skins replaced. Randall’s was able to get me in quickly and had my seats done and me back on my way in no time at all. Very professional and very reasonably priced, would highly recommend! Thank you Randall and Nick!

Randall has been taking care of all of my auto upholstery needs since 1991 everything from complete interior restoration to power windows and door locks to you name it. Just about anything to do with cars or boats he can handle it. His son Nick is as talented has well. Randalls Ultimate truck linings has the same high quality as his interiors. Randall and Nick sprayed my bed liner in over 3years ago and it's held up better than any liner I've ever had period. I rarely give reviews but his outstanding honesty and great business definitely deserve it.

Randall’s does excellent upholstery work. I was need a leather seat repaired where it was ripped and cracked. They were able to fix it perfectly! Very nice, very fairly priced, I would recommend to anyone need some work done!

Randall is a great guy who does excellent work for an affordable price! He's already done the whole interior of my 68 Mustang coupe and a outside cover, that keeps me warm in my new John Deere Gator! Thank you Mr Randall, and your son to!!

Wonderful, quality work. I made an appointment to replace my headliner on my MK6 GTI two weeks in advance and couldn't be happier with the end result. The quoted price was fair and on point with other estimates around Asheville and the same day turnaround was awesome. The shop's old school; no computers and cash or checks only.

Well theres not alot of people to choose from for this line of work since Als art craft closed down. I know James out in Fletcher does good work but theyre so busy I thought I'd see what these guys could do. Told him I needed an estimate on installing a suede headliner. He told me there was no way to install suede as a headliner because it was to heavy. Ive had 3 suede headliners done in the past and they have never done that. After that i decided I'd pass on these guys.
They did a wonderful job fixing our Chrysler 300 driver's seat. They were fast and it looks great! We highly recommend them.
Awesome experiance super helpful and accomadating
